params.q: What is the fine for drunk driving in India for a first offence?

search_parameters.q: What is the fine for drunk driving in India for a first offence?

response.markdown:
For a **first offence** of drunk driving in India under Section 185 of the Motor Vehicles Act (as amended in 2019), the penalty is a **fine of up to ₹10,000** and/or **imprisonment of up to 6 months**. [0] [1] [2] [3] [4] [5] The fine applies uniformly across all vehicle types (two-wheeler, four-wheeler, commercial) and all states. A repeat offence within 3 years carries a ₹15,000 fine and/or up to 2 years imprisonment, plus possible licence suspension or cancellation. [6]
